description:
Patterns is a private OCD journal and self-help practice companion for noticing patterns, delaying compulsions, and practising exposure and response prevention (ERP).

FREE TO USE

• Record urges, triggers, anxiety, and responses
• Keep a private daily journal
• Delay compulsions with guided timers
• Practise guided ERP exercises
• Complete Y-BOCS self-checks
• Choose factual Calm Insights instead of calculated scores and streaks
• Access coping and urgent-support tools

PATTERNS PRO - ONE-TIME PURCHASE

• Build detailed exposure hierarchies
• Organise exposure materials and practice plans
• Follow structured recovery programs
• Use action planning and implementation intentions
• Practise urge surfing, response prevention, and uncertainty
• Run behavioural experiments
• Explore activity summaries and deeper reflections

Journal entries, OCD records, ratings, and reflections remain on your device. Patterns does not require an account. Manual exports create an unencrypted JSON backup or PDF only where you choose to save or share it. Optional anonymous usage analytics are off by default and never include personal OCD content, generated summaries, locale, or language choice.

Patterns is a self-help tool. It does not diagnose or treat OCD and is not a replacement for qualified professional care or emergency support.
promotionalText: Private OCD journaling, factual Calm Insights, and guided ERP practice. No account, no ads, and one optional lifetime Pro unlock.
whatsNew:
Patterns 1.10 introduces a calmer way to reflect and practise.

NEW

• Calm Insights can replace calculated scores, streaks, and consistency percentages with factual activity counts
• Journal, tracking, compulsion-delay, and ERP sessions end with a clear Done for now action
• Optional interfaces in English, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Japanese, Spanish, and French
• Reminders and PDF reports follow your selected language and regional formats

Your entries and recovery notes stay exactly as written. Language and Calm Insights choices remain on this device and are not included in analytics or exported backups.
